reason: E1 supports the analogy to γ/γ′ interfaces and the role of moderate negative misfit in enhancing creep resistance, but it does not provide evidence for coherent interfaces in HEA multilayers specifically, nor does it directly demonstrate that such interfaces slow atomic diffusion or act as dislocation barriers in the proposed multilayer system.
premises: Coherent interfaces in multilayers create local lattice misfit strain fields
These strain fields act as barriers to dislocation nucleation and motion
These strain fields also slow atomic diffusion
The mechanism is analogous to γ/γ′ interfaces in Ni-based superalloys
Moderate negative misfit enhances interfacial coherency and creep resistance
